evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Most models are built separately for one task and a fixed set of inputs and outputs, and each relies on a prescribed subset of diagnostics rather than structuring the full multimodal observation set to extract global, cross-signal information about the discharge.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: In this work, we extend the TokaMark benchmark with two groups of tasks for actuator action inversion and disruption prediction, yielding 20 MAST tasks in six groups with explicit schemas and evaluation protocols.
